//! MR-009b Wave 0 ADMIT fixture — the `test-support` cargo-feature gate is a TEST-DOUBLE gate.
//!
//! The in-memory doubles are consumed CROSS-CRATE in non-test lib code (e.g. `KmsEngine::new()` at
//! ~90 sites), so they can NOT move to `#[cfg(test)]` (crate-local). They live behind a
//! `test-support` cargo feature that downstream crates enable as a DEV-dependency. Wave 0 teaches
//! the `no-in-memory-durable-store` scanner that a `test-support`-gated in-memory store/backing is a
//! test double (admitted), exactly like `#[cfg(test)]`, WITHOUT admitting any real production store.
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

/// The Wave-2+ shape: the role struct's backend enum keeps the `Pg` (pool) variant as the
/// always-compiled PRODUCTION default, and the in-memory `Memory(..)` variant + its `Inner` backing
/// are gated behind `test-support`. The production-compiled type presents NO in-memory backing →
/// durable-by-default → ADMITTED.
#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
struct Inner {
    partitions: HashMap<(String, String), BTreeMap<String, TupleRow>>,
}

pub enum TupleBackend {
    #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
    Memory(Arc<Mutex<Inner>>),
    Pg(PgTupleBacking),
}

/// A durable-by-contract *Store whose only in-memory arm is test-support-gated — ADMITTED.
pub struct TupleStore {
    backend: TupleBackend,
}

/// A whole in-memory *Store DIRECTLY gated behind the single-feature form — a test double, ADMITTED.
#[cfg(feature = "test-support")]
pub struct PrincipalStore {
    inner: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, PrincipalRow>>>,
}
